description: Creates a campaign as a DRAFT. Nothing is sent and no quota is used. Before calling: read brand_get for the voice, pick a template from templates_list, and pick the audience from segments_list. You fill the content blocks; Hollerpost renders the email with the brand header, footer and unsubscribe link. Optionally ask one survey question (survey) that readers answer with one click. Returns the id, audience_count and a preview_url to share with the person. Next step: campaign_preview, then campaign_send_test. Retail promo in one call (template promo): {"info_bar": {"text": "Free shipping over $99", "url": "https://shop.example/shipping"}, "image_url": "https://images.hollerpost.com/...", "image_alt": "...", "image_link": "https://shop.example/sale", "heading": "Up to 30% off", "body_md": "...", "cta_text": "Shop the sale", "cta_url": "https://shop.example/sale", "cta_repeat": "bottom", "layout": "grid-2", "sections": [{"heading": "Maple cue", "price": "$129", "image_url": "https://images.hollerpost.com/...", "image_alt": "Maple cue", "cta_text": "Shop now", "cta_url": "https://shop.example/p/1"}], "fine_print": "Ends Sunday. Not valid with other offers.", "theme": {"button_style": "outline", "button_shape": "pill"}}. The footer link buttons, Follow us icons and disclaimer come from the brand (brand_set_footer), not the blocks. Every send also gets a View in browser link, the mailing address and an unsubscribe link automatically. Requires API key scope: draft.

signup_form_id.description: Form UUID from segments_list audiences or page_get. Only confirmed, active, unsuppressed email subscribers from this form, resolved when sending.

tags.description: Send to subscribed contacts that have ANY of these tags (one tag is the usual case). Get tags from segments_list.

all.description: Send to every subscribed contact in the workspace.

audience.description: Who gets it: {"tags": ["vip"]} for tagged contacts, or {"all": true} for every subscribed contact, or {"signup_form_id": "<UUID>"} for a waitlist.

blocks.description: Content blocks for the template. Check templates_list for the blocks_schema of the template you pick. Never send raw HTML: Hollerpost renders the blocks with the brand header, footer, unsubscribe link and address. The plain template takes no images.

body_md.description: Body copy in Markdown: blank line between paragraphs, "- " lists, **bold**, *italic*, [text](https://...). To add a picture, put it on a line by itself: ![What it shows](https://...) or, clickable, [![What it shows](https://...)](https://link). Images inside a sentence are refused.

cta_repeat.description: "bottom": show the main button right after body_md AND again after the sections (retail promo style). Needs cta_text, cta_url and sections.

cta_text.description: Button label, for example "Book a visit".

fine_print.description: Offer terms in small print at the very end, for example "Ends Sunday 11:59pm. Not valid with other offers." Plain text with **bold**, *italic* and [links](https://...).

image_alt.description: Alt text for the hero image. Required whenever image_url is set.

image_link.description: Where a click on the hero image goes (https URL). Defaults to cta_url.

image_url.description: Optional hero image at the top (https URL). For more pictures use image lines in body_md or sections.

text.description: Short line, for example "Free shipping on orders over $99".

url.description: Where a click on the bar goes (https URL).

info_bar.description: Dark band across the top of the email. An object sets it for this email (replacing the brand default); "off" hides the brand default for this email.

layout.description: How sections show. stack (default): one per row. grid-2: product cards two across (image, heading, price, short copy, button), stacked on phones.

sections.description: Optional: up to 8 sections after body_md, each with its own sub-heading, image, copy and button, divided by a line. Use for a promotion with several products or a newsletter with several stories. Each needs at least a heading, body_md or image_url. Up to 20 images per email in total.

body_md.description: Copy for this section. Same Markdown as body_md, image lines allowed.

image_alt.description: What the image shows. Required when image_url is set.

image_link.description: Where a click on the image goes. Defaults to cta_url.

image_position.description: top (default): image above the copy. left or right: image beside the copy on wide screens, stacked on phones.

image_url.description: Section image (https URL). Use email_image_upload first to host it on Hollerpost.

price.description: Price line, for example "$129 (was $179)". Shown under the heading; with layout "grid-2" it sits on the product card.

theme.description: This email’s colors and buttons; anything left out follows the brand (brand_set_theme).

button_shape.description: pill: fully round ends. rounded: the brand corner radius.

button_style.description: solid: filled with the brand color. outline: border and label only, the retail look.

surface.description: Email card color. A dark surface gets light text and light outline buttons automatically.

text.description: Body text color. Needs at least 4.5:1 contrast with surface (campaign_preview warns low_contrast_text).

theme_id.description: Page theme id from templates_list email_themes. Matches its email-safe palette, local font stacks and shapes. Unknown ids use the current default.

name.description: Internal campaign name (recipients do not see it).

preheader.description: Preview text shown after the subject in most inboxes.

survey.description: Ask one survey question in the email; readers answer with one click. The survey must be open (survey_update with status "open") before the campaign can be test-sent or scheduled.

question_id.description: Id of one question in that survey. Only rating, nps and single-choice questions (one_click: true) can be answered from an email.

survey_id.description: Survey id (a UUID), as returned by survey_create or surveys_list.
